_comment: Aggregated SxS Overall Paper Quality verdict using the paper's positional-bias-mitigation protocol (App. F.3): run twice, swap order, aggregate. paper-orc-generated and human-original are labeled the same across both runs.
aggregation_rule: WIN for X iff X wins both runs; LOSS iff Y wins both; TIE iff one win + one tie OR two ties OR one A-wins + one B-wins.
consistency: Both runs agreed; positional bias did not flip the verdict.
primary_drivers: Citation breadth: 57 vs 26 unique citations in Intro + Related Work (paper-orc cites foundational psychometric anchors that the original draft omits).
Explicit causal-chain teaser figure and 7-bullet contribution list at the end of the Introduction.
Parallel-structured Related Work subsections with bridge-to-our-method synthesis sentences.
ACL-canonical citation style (\citep / \citet uniformly) vs mixed \cite in the original.
Compact 8-page main-text budget that improved precision of prose.
where_human_original_is_stronger: Explicit Cronbach alpha display equation in Methodology.
Methodology-pipeline schematic figure as a top-level overview.
Memorable subsection titles ('Caught in the Act', 'The Cascade') that may be valued by some reviewers.
